the information diffuses on social media in real time, the diffusion process is highly dynamic and that the diffusion process depends on the type of information.
the diffusion of information on social media is highly influenced by the social context and that the real time aspect plays an important role in this process.
(1) Information diffuses in real-time on social networks and (2) the role of different individuals in the propagation process is important for the analysis of social media.

the following research questions: How does information diffuse in social networks?
real time analyses on information diffusion and its impact on the underlying social networks.
the following questions: How can we analyze real-time information diffusion in social networks with large scale data?

we have investigated real-time analysis methods for social media with a specific focus on information diffusion and we have implemented and evaluated these methods on a large scale.
the proposed real-time analysis methods for social media are feasible, and can be used to gain new knowledge about the diffusion process of information in social media.
real-time analysis of information diffusion on social media is possible with a combination of conventional and novel data intensive computation approaches.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we want to understand the dynamics of social media and its users.
we are interested in understanding how information diffuses and how we can analyze this process in real time.

we want to understand how information diffuses on social networks and how this process is affected by different factors such as the structure of the social network, the content of the information itself, and the users that are involved in the process.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the social media is a complex system that is constantly evolving and that the information diffuses in a non-linear fashion.
the real time analysis of information diffusion is a challenging problem and requires a new infrastructure to support it.
the analysis of social media is not only about the analysis of large datasets, it is also about the analysis of the data as it happens, in near real time.
